decisions.reason: Repeated gold-medal recognition in 2023 and 2024 strongly signals realized value, and as a seasonal line extension it is cheap for the bakery to continue.
It remained on its own page for two years, suggesting acceptable demand, and as a rye-bread variant close to the firm's core range it is inexpensive to keep while upside remains.

Its continued standalone presence through 2024 indicates sufficient seasonal demand, and keeping a marzipan stollen variant preserves assortment breadth at limited incremental cost despite its more niche appeal.
